TS057 callback-name-prefix

A callback is named after the function that hands it over, so the call history reads from the name alone.

languages: go javascript odin python rust typescript zig
severity: info
default: opt-in
group: stable

TigerStyle: "When a single function calls out to a helper function or callback, prefix the name of the helper function with the name of the calling function to show the call history. For example, `read_sector()` and `read_sector_callback()`."
